background: Al Rajhi Bank is the largest Islamic bank in the world by assets and the largest retail bank in Saudi Arabia, funded by a large base of retail deposits and lending mainly to Saudi households under Sharia-compliant structures.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 8 Dec 2025. The site holds no regulatory capital or liquidity figures for the bank, so the ratings carry the assessment, and they point to solid single-A credit with nothing pulling either way. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
